text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: This paper is not focused on land use/land cover (LULC) prediction or simulation. Instead, it presents a trait-based risk assessment framework to quantify impacts of past and projected agricultural land-use changes on European farmland bird populations. It does not implement spatially explicit national-scale LULC modeling or future LULC scenario mapping with quantitative accuracy metrics. The primary focus is ecological assessment of biodiversity risk linked to agricultural changes, not on LULC prediction. No spatially explicit LULC projections or accuracy assessments are provided. Therefore, it fails the core inclusion criteria requiring national-scale spatial LULC prediction and mapped outputs.)
